ResearchProjectDef.label: Rare Earth Smelting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop and reinforce the theory behind extracting rare earth minerals from stone chunks on a small scale.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Improved Rare Earth Smelting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improve your understanding and abilities of extracting rare earth minerals from stone chunks on a practical scale.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Radiation Experiments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Explore particle radiation by studying the effects of alpha-particles on stone chunks. These experiments yield a small amount of uranium as a by-product.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Efficient Rare Earth Smelting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improve your understanding and abilities of extracting rare earth minerals from stone chunks on a large scale.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Particle Radiation Theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master and prove particle radiation theory by observing the effects of alpha-particles on stone chunks in a high-energy environment. These experiments yield a substantial amount of uranium as a by-product.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Industrial Rare Earth Smelting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master your understanding and abilities of extracting rare earth minerals from stone chunks on an industrial scale.
